methods: logAction(action, entityType, entityId, performedBy, oldValues, newValues)

recommended_phases.title: Phase 1 — Foundation: employee, policy, audit
recommended_phases.rationale: These are leaf modules with no inter-module dependencies. Employee and policy provide reference data consumed by balance and leave. Audit is a cross-cutting concern required by GP-002. Build them first so downstream modules can depend on stable interfaces.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2 — Balance module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends on policy (for entitlementDays), employee (for employee existence), and audit (GP-002). Implements the hybrid usedDays/remainingDays model already defined in DOMAIN.md. Must be built before leave because leave approval triggers balance deduction.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3 — Leave module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends on all other modules: balance (deduct on approve, restore on cancel/reject), policy (validate entitlement), employee (validate employee/manager), audit (GP-002). The approveLeaveRequest method is the critical integration point that calls IBalanceService.deductBalance.

app_notes:
DESIGN FORK RESOLVED: The DOMAIN.md Balance model already stores both `usedDays` (incrementing counter) and `remainingDays` (derived as totalEntitlement - usedDays). This is the established architecture — no guessing required. The hybrid model supports both reporting styles: remainingDays for quick balance checks, usedDays for audit trails and accrual reconciliation.

LAYER BOUNDARIES:
- Presentation: routes + controllers (Fastify route handlers, request validation, RBAC enforcement per GP-005)
- Application: service implementations (orchestration, transaction boundaries, cross-module calls)
- Domain: models, service interfaces, repository interfaces (pure contracts, no infrastructure)
- Infrastructure: repository implementations, DB connection (Knex/raw SQL behind repository interfaces per GP-001)

DEPENDENCY FLOW (inward only):
leave → balance → {policy, employee, audit}
No module depends on leave. Balance depends only on leaf modules. Leaf modules have zero inter-module dependencies.

CRITICAL INTEGRATION: leave.approveLeaveRequest() calls balance.deductBalance() and audit.logAction() within a single transaction. leave.rejectLeaveRequest() and leave.cancelLeaveRequest() call balance.restoreBalance() when the leave was previously approved.

RBAC (GP-005): Controllers enforce roles — only managers/HR can approve/reject; employees can create/submit/cancel their own requests; HR can view balance reports.
